View 2261 Waterloo Street V6R 3H2 rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 4 bed, 2 bath, 1500 Sq. Ft. house. 2261 Waterloo Street is currently on market.
Charming Kitsilano character home!

Fantastic location on Waterloo between West 6th and West 7th Avenues. This charming 1500sf 4-bedroom, 2-bath home is in a very quiet neighbourhood, yet close to all shops, services, restaurants and transit on both Broadway and West 4th Avenue.

The main floor features a spacious living room with recessed lighting, a decorative fireplace, and fir flooring that is carried throughout the entire main floor. The kitchen offers plenty of storage, granite counters, gas range and stainless fridge and dishwasher. This bright and cheerful kitchen also has a skylight over the eating area and a stained-glass interior window.  There are 2 nice sized bedrooms on this level, all with recessed lighting, as well as a full bath with heated tile floor.

The lower level of the home offers a laundry area with a window to the rear garden and door to the backyard. There is also a recreation room with space for an office, as well as 2 more nice sized bedrooms and a second full bathroom with a heated floor.

The yard and garden offer lots of sunshine and feature a patio and an attached storage shed.
Street parking only (there is ample).  No pets and absolutely no smoking.

Walk score: 98
Transit score: 70
Bike score: 93

Professionally managed by Macdonald Commercial RES Ltd.
